name: optimize_rust_slice_intersection
description: Optimizes an O(n*m) slice intersection that scans with Vec::contains to O(n) using a HashSet
prompts: The function `common(a: &[i32], b: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>` in src/lib.rs returns the elements of `a` that also appear in `b`, preserving a's order and duplicates. It tests membership with `b.contains(&x)`, a linear scan, so the whole call is O(n*m) and far too slow when both slices have tens of thousands of elements. Rewrite `common` to test membership in O(1) using a HashSet built from `b`, keeping the exact same result: each element of `a` that is present in `b`, in a's original order, with duplicates preserved. Keep the function name and signature.
